data.text: I agree to the 18-ton cap this month and the recovery limits: 3 each at 20 tons, 1 each at 10, and zero at 5. That completes everyone’s agreement for this month. I’ll stick to my cap, and once we see the next stock, we can follow the recovery plan or review our limits together if we’re back at 100. Let’s protect the lake rather than punish any breach with more overfishing.
